$comment: Open-source lab registry — the owner's 30-repo research index, transcribed into a governed artifact. Machine half; the human half is docs/OPEN_SOURCE_LAB_REGISTRY.md and the gate is scripts/check-lab-registry.mjs. deployedInLab is TRUE only for services scripts/run-live-lanes.sh actually starts today; classification records intent, not deployment. v2 (2026-08-21, second owner research report): every entry now carries ownerRole (must exist in docs/agent/org-roster.json — the gate enforces it), priorityTier (P0 prove-the-product / P1 prove-the-enterprise-workflow / P2 ecosystem depth), credentialClass, mutationsAllowed (false across the board — a true requires a decision record naming its approval gate), and lastReviewed. Seven repositories added from the same report.
transcribedFrom: live scheduler n/a — registry re-transcribed 2026-08-22 on report v3 intake (48 entries)

rule.boundary: external system → source adapter → normalized evidence → freshness + provenance + contradictions → deterministic policy → verdict
rule.neverRule: No repository's code is copied or embedded into SignalGrid until its licence has been reviewed against the distribution model. Studying, deploying as a separate lab service, and speaking a wire protocol are not the same act as embedding code.

entries.basis: owner research report v3 2026-08-22 (open-source lab + integration stack), verify before any code reuse
entries.role: Secrets management — the report names this one of the three most important gaps in the stack. Target state: connector/API credentials and service identities out of env files and into scoped, rotatable leases with audit; secret-zero, unseal and root-token procedures kept OUT of any agent's reach; never returns a secret conversationally. Adoption is backlog row 35 (secret model + naming + rotation runbook BEFORE the first stored secret, the METRIC_STANDARDS pattern applied to credentials). mutationsAllowed stays FALSE until the row-35 adoption DR exists — DR-008's gate enforces exactly this, and it fired on the first attempt to record otherwise.
